description: Native Instagram Reels hashtag search — engagement.views + viewsSource, location, commercial flags. Flat 2 credits. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

datePosted.description: last_24_hours | last_week | last_month | last_year (aliases: today, this_week, this_month, this_year).

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 200). Flat 2 credits per call.
